{{Quote|...ancient records from numerous worlds... depending on when they were created or whether the creators were citizens of the Old Republic... may or may not have adopted Standard Time Parts as units of measure.|[[Tionne Solusar]]|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
'''Standard Time Part''', also known as '''ST''' or '''Standard Time Unit''', was a [[Galactic Standard Time/Legends|standardized]] unit of measure of time{{Fact}} and was the basic unit of time employed in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="AGSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> The [[Historical Council]]'s [[Galactic Standard Calendar|Galactic Calendar]] used Standard Time Part. [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had fourteen hundred ST and [[Polneye]] had eighteen hundred ST in a day.<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>
